_help: Read by tools/ops/backup_learner.py (and later the S1-4 watchdog). The scheduled tasks run the DEPLOYMENT CLONE's copy of this file, so a change here reaches them by commit + push to main and the clone's next fast-forward. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_backup_dir: E: is a different physical disk from C: (Samsung 970 EVO, 46.9 GB free on 2026-10-19). Z: (WD HDD 4 TB) is the alternative if E: fills. NOT YET CHOSEN BY THE USER (2026-10-21): the tool refuses any folder on the learner's own volume.
_status_file: Outside the clone, so the backup never writes a path there; %LOCALAPPDATA% is expanded. The watchdog (S1-4) and tools/status.py read it.
